# Campaign Asia

> Campaign Asia is the leading digital marketing and advertising news source covering the Asia-Pacific region, with focus on digital transformation, media buying, and industry leadership.

Campaign Asia covers advertising industry trends, executive movements, and digital marketing developments across Asia-Pacific markets including China, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, and broader regional expansion. The site features news, case studies, and analysis of major players like Leo Burnett, Ogilvy & Mather, and TNS.

## Key Topics

- Asia-Pacific advertising
- Digital marketing
- Executive leadership
- Media buying
- China expansion
- Online advertising platforms
- Regional collaboration
